title: HS360-Day10-RNA-seq-rep1
characteristics_ch1.1: cell type: day 10, middle of self-pattering stage
treatment_protocol_ch1: In brief, at Day 0 HS360 hESCs grown in E8 were collected with Accutase and seeded in Geltrex precoated 12 well dishes. Single-cell suspensions were transferred to E8 medium containing 10 µM Rock inhibitor and at Day 1, the culture medium was switched to neural induction medium (NIM; Advanced DMEM/F12, 1% GlutaMAX, 1% Penicillin/Streptomycin, 1% N2). During days 2 to 6, media were changed daily and the LSX combo (LDN-193189, SB431542, XAV939) was added fresh to NIM. Cells were collected at Day 7 for passaging into the self patterning phase, counted and seeded on 12 well plates sequentially precoated with polyornithine (PO), fibronectin (F) and Geltrex. At Day 7 the Stage II neural self-patterning (NSPM) medium (Advanced DMEM/F12, 1% GlutaMAX, 1% Penicillin/Streptomycin, 1% N2, 1% B27) was supplemented with 10 µM Rock inhibitor. Culture medium was changed daily till day 13.  For cells that were exposed to either 50-400 nM citalopram, fresh media with citalopram was added every day from Day 1 until collection day (Day 6, 10 and 13)
growth_protocol_ch1: Human embryonic stem cells HS360 (Karolinska Institutet, Sweden, RRID:CVCL_C202) were maintained in Essential 8™ Medium, in feeder-free conditions on Geltrex™ Matrix solution pre-coated culture plates.Culture media were replaced daily and cells were routinely passaged at 75-85% confluency using 0.5 mM EDTA in ratios between 1:3 to 1:6.
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was extracted from cultured cells using Norgen RNA/DNA purification kit or Qiagen RNeasy kit and treated with DNase according to manufacturer´s instructions.
extract_protocol_ch1.1: Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA Library Prep kit was used to contruct the sequencing library according to manufacturer´s instructions. Libraries were sequenced on an Illumina Novaseq 6000 S1 flow cell with 100bp pair end reads.
data_processing: BBDuk (BBMap v. 34.56) was used to reomve and trim low-quality reads and adaptor sequences with the following configurations: ktrim=r k=23 mink=11 hdist=1 tbo tpe qtrim=r trimq=15 maq=15 minlen=36 forcetrimright=149
data_processing.1: Reads were mapped to the human genome/transcriptome ENSEMBL GRCh38 2020-A using hisat2 v2.1.0
data_processing.2: FeatureCounts v.1.4.6-p1 was used to count the reads mapping to the features using default configurations
data_processing.3: Downstream normalisation and differential expression analysis was performed using R software EdgeR package v3.38.4.
data_processing.5: Supplementary files format and content: Count file with data matrix with unnormalized counts for each sample. Additionaly, ""cpm.csv"" contains a normalized count matrix (counts per million) for all samples.

characteristics_ch1.1: cell type: day 13, end of self-pattering stage, exposed to 400 nM citalopram
treatment_protocol_ch1: In brief, at Day 0 HS360 hESCs grown in E8 were collected with Accutase and seeded in Geltrex precoated 12 well dishes. Single-cell suspensions were transferred to E8 medium containing 10 µM Rock inhibitor and at Day 1, the culture medium was switched to neural induction medium (NIM; Advanced DMEM/F12, 1% GlutaMAX, 1% Penicillin/Streptomycin, 1% N2). During days 2 to 6, media were changed daily and the LSX combo (LDN-193189, SB431542, XAV939) was added fresh to NIM. Cells were collected at Day 7 for passaging into the self patterning phase, counted and seeded on 12 well plates sequentially precoated with polyornithine (PO), fibronectin (F) and Geltrex. At Day 7 the Stage II neural self-patterning (NSPM) medium (Advanced DMEM/F12, 1% GlutaMAX, 1% Penicillin/Streptomycin, 1% N2, 1% B27) was supplemented with 10 µM Rock inhibitor. Culture medium was changed daily till day 13.  For cells that were exposed to either 50-400 nM citalopram, fresh media with citalopram was added every day from Day 1 until collection day (Day 6, 10 and 13)
growth_protocol_ch1: Human embryonic stem cells HS360 (Karolinska Institutet, Sweden, RRID:CVCL_C202) were maintained in Essential 8™ Medium, in feeder-free conditions on Geltrex™ Matrix solution pre-coated culture plates.Culture media were replaced daily and cells were routinely passaged at 75-85% confluency using 0.5 mM EDTA in ratios between 1:3 to 1:6.
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was extracted from cultured cells using Norgen RNA/DNA purification kit or Qiagen RNeasy kit and treated with DNase according to manufacturer´s instructions.
extract_protocol_ch1.1: Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA Library Prep kit was used to contruct the sequencing library according to manufacturer´s instructions. Libraries were sequenced on an Illumina Novaseq 6000 S1 flow cell with 100bp pair end reads.
data_processing: BBDuk (BBMap v. 34.56) was used to reomve and trim low-quality reads and adaptor sequences with the following configurations: ktrim=r k=23 mink=11 hdist=1 tbo tpe qtrim=r trimq=15 maq=15 minlen=36 forcetrimright=149
data_processing.1: Reads were mapped to the human genome/transcriptome ENSEMBL GRCh38 2020-A using hisat2 v2.1.0
data_processing.2: FeatureCounts v.1.4.6-p1 was used to count the reads mapping to the features using default configurations
data_processing.3: Downstream normalisation and differential expression analysis was performed using R software EdgeR package v3.38.4.
data_processing.5: Supplementary files format and content: Count file with data matrix with unnormalized counts for each sample. Additionaly, ""cpm.csv"" contains a normalized count matrix (counts per million) for all samples.
